messages:
sophia_sales: Quick sync — SiennaHealth POC. They want to serve a custom model (Sienna-Dialog-13B fork) + a 4-bit quant variant. Requirements: p50 latency ~150ms, support for KV cache (long convo state), and SOC2-ready controls. They asked about pricing for ~100k tokens/day. Any immediate red flags or items we need to surface to legal/infra?
leo_se: @sophia_sales thanks. couple quick q's — what format is the model in (GGUF / HF)? do they have a tokenizer file? are there custom ops?
jordan_sienna: we can host HF weights (transformers/ggml exports available). tokenizer.json + merges included. no custom CUDA ops in their repo. will share link.
raj_infra: 4-bit quant is usually fine but depends how it's produced. if it's QLoRA-style or a quantized GGUF we need to run our compatibility scan. also need sample inference traces to estimate batch sizing for p50 150ms.
anya_security: flagging security questionnaire items: data residency, KMS for keys, and model provenance attestation. we'll need an internal PII review — do they plan to store user convo history in our infra or send back to their own storage?
jordan_sienna: convos stay in customer PII store; Redwood just does inference. they want optional KV caching on our side for latency — cache keys should be customer-owned, ok to use Redwood-managed cache if KMS is used.
leo_se: ok — for caching, we can enable prefix/KV caching per-customer and encrypt keys with their KMS. note: caching increases complexity for rollouts (cache invalidation on model switch).
sophia_sales: pricing question from them: roughly what would Dedicated monthly look like to hit 100k tokens/day with this model & caching? also what happens cost-wise if we use 4-bit vs fp16?
leo_se: rough thumb: with caching + 4-bit on a single dedicated 80GB GPU pool, they'd likely hit target with one dedicated instance for baseline traffic. price variance: 4-bit reduces GPU memory & throughput cost — expect 20–40% lower token cost vs fp16 depending on kernel efficiency. exact quote needs bench results.
raj_infra: I'll kick off a quick compatibility run. need the model artifact URL (gguf/hf) + a small prompt set (~20 examples) and one full convo to reproduce KV behavior. I can start on dev cluster.
sophia_sales: Jordan — can you drop the link and sample prompts here? also include the security contact if possible so we can accelerate the questionnaire.
jordan_sienna: link: https://s3.company-sienna.com/models/sienna-dialog-13b/weights.gguf
prompts: shared in the drive (link DM'd). sec contact: elena@ siennahealth.com
deploy-bot: [build] compatibility-scan job queued: job_id=cs-7901234567-1. runner: dev-infer-02
leo_se: one gotcha — some GGUF exports use custom attention kernels that don't map cleanly to our optimized ops. if the scan shows fallback to generic kernels, p50 may rise. will report.
anya_security: also please send their SOC2 report if available. for KMS we need an expected key rotation policy and whether they require HSM-backed keys.
raj_infra: quick note on bench plan: will try 4-bit quant variant first with batching disabled to measure pure latency, then enable continuous batching and KV caching. commands I'll run:
```
redwood scan-compat --model-url https://s3.company-sienna.com/models/sienna-dialog-13b/weights.gguf --output=scan.json
redwood bench --model-path ./local/gguf --prompts ./prompts.json --mode=latency --bs=1
```
leo_se: perfect. if scan fails for 4-bit we try an int8/qtune or ask them for an HF fp16 tarball.
sophia_sales: timeline: can we have a compatibility + latency sketch within 48hrs? they want to decide on reserved capacity next week.
raj_infra: I'll have initial scan + perf numbers within 36 hrs. if we need kernel work it's longer.
jordan_sienna: thanks — will share prompts & SOC2 link within the hour.
anya_security: once we have SOC2 and KMS requirements, I'll fill out the security questionnaire sections on our end and loop legal if anything non-standard.
leo_se: also thinking about model variants — recommend we onboard: (1) full fp16 HF tarball, (2) 4-bit GGUF variant, (3) a slimmed `dialog-lite` distilled variant for tails. that gives fallbacks for latency/throughput.
sophia_sales: agree — include fallback policy in the proposal. Jordan — are you ok with us requesting those three artifacts?
jordan_sienna: yes, will ask engineering to export fp16 + distilled. should be doable.
deploy-bot: [status] cs-7901234567-1 started on dev-infer-02 (est ~22m)
leo_se: last note — billing model: we can show estimated token-unit costs with and without caching. caching can halve the token cost for long convo flows. I'll prepare a short estimate table once we have bench numbers.
sophia_sales: thanks team — let's reconvene after the scan. I'll draft a one-page POC plan (timeline, deliverables, ask from Sienna) and share.
raj_infra: ack. starting scan now.
anya_security: acked. will prep the security section draft.
jordan_sienna: shared the artifacts and SOC2 link — thanks all! :thumbsup:
